Definition
[Notation: points in $\mathbb R^{n+m}$] 1. appC:C.6-def-1\group Inverse and Implicit Function Theorems Write \[ (x,y)=(x_1,\ldots ,x_n,y_1,\ldots ,y_m) \] for $x\in \mathbb R^n$ and $y\in \mathbb R^m$.

Let $U\subset \mathbb R^{n+m}$ be open, let $\mathbf f=(f^1,\ldots ,f^m):U\to \mathbb R^m$ be $C^1$, fix $(x_0,y_0)\in U$, and set $z_0=\mathbf f(x_0,y_0)$.
